title: A decision-basis contract for auditable LLM-assisted medical billing verification: deterministic rules, verbatim evidence, and fail-closed abstention
abstract: arXiv:2609.12156v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This work presents a proof of concept for auditable LLM-assisted medical billing verification based on a decision-basis contract. The contract separates deterministic checks of versioned fee-catalog rules from LLM-based assessment of free-text documentation. The deterministic layer resolves the applicable catalog release and checks code availability, quantity limits, and exclusions. The semantic layer classifies each claimed item as supported, contradicted, or missing required information. Support and contradiction require a verbatim evidence span; unavailable rule context, unsuccessful assessment, or missing required evidence prevents support through fail-closed abstention. We evaluated four locally run open-weight models on a synthetic catalog and 36 curated cases under the contract, an ablation without explicit documentation requirements, and an end-to-end baseline. translated_title: 用于可审计的LLM辅助医疗计费验证的决策依据契约：确定性规则、逐字证据与故障关闭式弃权
translated_abstract: 这项工作提出了一种基于决策依据契约的可审计LLM辅助医疗计费验证的概念验证。该契约将版本化收费目录规则的确定性检查与基于LLM的自由文本文档评估分离开来。确定性层解析适用的目录版本，并检查代码可用性、数量限制和排除项。语义层将每个申报项目分类为“被支持”、“被矛盾”或“缺失所需信息”。“支持”和“矛盾”判定需要提供逐字证据片段；当规则上下文不可用、评估不成功或所需证据缺失时，系统会通过故障关闭式弃权机制阻止给出“支持”结论。我们在一个合成目录和36个精选案例上，分别对该契约下的四个本地运行的开源权重模型、去除明确文档要求的消融版本以及端到端基线进行了评估。结果一致性因模型而异，未显示出一致的优（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种“决策依据契约”，通过将版本化收费目录的确定性规则检查与LLM语义评估相分离、要求逐字证据片段支持结论、并以故障关闭式弃权防止在证据缺失时给出支持判定，从而实现可审计的LLM辅助医疗计费验证。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a decision-basis contract for auditable LLM-assisted medical billing verification, which separates deterministic checks of versioned fee-catalog rules from LLM-based semantic assessment, requires verbatim evidence spans for support or contradiction, and enforces fail-closed abstention to prevent unsupported conclusions when evidence is missing.
